title: risk_review.py crashes on a diff with non-UTF-8 bytes
problem: platform/security/risk_review.py's git() helper runs subprocess with text=True and no errors= handler, so a diff that adds binary or Latin-1 fixtures raises UnicodeDecodeError and the review prints no checklist.
evidence: 2026-11-26, private-monorepo PR #26 (import of ventures/einvoice-preflight with binary test fixtures): UnicodeDecodeError 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0xf3 in position 5645487, raised from risk_review.py line 509 (git diff -U0) via line 423 (git())
The same run got a full checklist, nothing blocked, from a copy with errors="replace" (docs/reports/ventures-2026-11-26-einvoice-landed.md)
change: Pass errors="replace" (or decode bytes with surrogateescape) in git(), and add a test with a binary file in the diff. This is a gate file, so land it in its own PR, judged by the old gate.
metric: risk_review.py exits normally on a diff that adds a non-UTF-8 file
